verdict.rationale: The GitHub README shows a terminal-launchable `zcode` command installed by script, with non-TUI arguments passed to an Agent CLI. It also documents a web server mode that can run without opening a browser (`--no-open`, `--port`, `--host`, token auth) and env-var configuration, which are building blocks for unattended or remote runs. However, nothing documents a non-interactive or one-shot prompt mode, CI usage, or exit-code and output handling for automation. The community note that it is GUI-only does not contradict the documented CLI. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless prompt execution, CI pipeline examples or integrations, machine-readable output/exit-code behavior, independent hands-on confirmation of automated use.
